# 3TATTAVA — Performance Ayurveda

> 3TATTAVA is a doctor-led Performance Ayurveda brand offering purified (Shodhit) Himalayan Shilajit in two formats: Shahjeet honey-shilajit single-serve sticks and RockResin shilajit resin. Products are NABL third-party lab-tested, Triphala-purified, and manufactured in an AYUSH-GMP certified facility. Formulated by Dr. Kashish Gupta (BAMS).

## Products
- [Shahjeet Sticks — Honey Shilajit](https://www.3tattava.com/products/shahjeet-sticks): 600mg Shodhit Shilajit + honey per single-serve stick, 30-pack. Tear, squeeze, perform. NABL tested, AYUSH-GMP.
- [RockResin — Shilajit Resin](https://www.3tattava.com/products/shodhit-shilajit-resin): Pure Himalayan Shilajit resin, ≥70% fulvic acid, Triphala-purified. (Launching soon.)
- [All Products](https://www.3tattava.com/products)
